{{DISPLAYTITLE:Research Toolkit: bibliography}}
{{Research Toolkit map}}
''Every source the [[The Principia Machina/Research Toolkit|Research Toolkit]] cites: 284 entries in three groups, one per part, then further reading. Each entry carries its key (the label the toolkit's pages link to), its citation as the research passes recorded it, its identifiers as links, and a note of how it was checked: what was fetched, on 2026-10-05 or 2026-10-06, and what could not be confirmed (marked UNVERIFIED). An entry is a pointer to a source, not a claim that the source is right.''

== How to read an entry ==

'''KEY''' &ndash; authors (year). Title. Venue, volume, pages. Identifiers: a DOI links through doi.org, an arXiv identifier to its abstract page. ''Checked:'' the research pass's own note.

Before relying on any entry in a register record, resolve its identifier yourself and look for retraction or correction notices ([[The Principia Machina/Research Toolkit/Manual#checklists|the manual's checklist]]); on this site a record cites literature only through its container's bibliography, by BIB ID ([[The Principia Machina/TPS/5.21 The bibliography|TPS 5.21]]). This page is not such a bibliography: it lies outside every container.

== Agent flow control ==

== Method ==

Four research passes ran on 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-06 (agent flow control; research methods; research tools; further dimensions), each reading its sources live and recording what it fetched; a fifth pass checked the original physics tools' citations. Where two passes cited one work, the entries were merged under one key and both check notes kept. Rate limits (HTTP 429 from Crossref and Semantic Scholar) and blocked pages are named in the notes; an entry checked from a secondary page says so. The passes' reports are kept whole in the project's records.

Back to [[The Principia Machina/Research Toolkit|the Research Toolkit]].
